recentItems.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Play LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6002aZvO6

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a brand-new open world action-adventure video game that invites players to embark on Bruce Wayne’s epic journey to become the hero of Gotham City. Forge a new family of allies with Jim Gordon, Catwoman, Robin, Nightwing, and Batgirl, and confront an ever-growing threat as you face The Joker, The Penguin, Mr. Freeze, Poison Ivy, Bane, and more. 

Inspired by decades of Batman films, television, comic books, and games, LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is jam-packed with Batman nostalgia, DC lore, and TT Games’ signature brand of fun-filled LEGO humor!

recentItems.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Launch Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2/

The Heroic Games have begun! 

Command your units across the map and fight to gain the upper hand in strategic, turn-based combat. Between matches, visit locations within the city of Dagsion to prepare for battle by recruiting allies, honing your skills at the training ground, and strengthening your bonds. Or venture out into the surrounding lands to complete quests, gather resources, defeat roaming enemies, and more.

Follow the paths of four Heroes and fight to save the future from ruin in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave.

recentItems.title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Play Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon - Classic HD - on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6007aZWoc

Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series is finally making its international debut!  

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon. 

Every time you enter, the Mystery Dungeon takes on a new form. Items and monsters change with every expedition, and each new journey begins from Level 1. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, gather equipment and items to grow stronger, and explore in search of treasure. The deeper you go, the more powerful the monsters become. 

Based on the original game from 1993, this title features upgraded HD graphics, a new opening movie, and adjustable difficulty settings. 

#DragonQuestHeroes #TornekosMysteryDungeon
